items.name: Priced from a rate reference with history
items.statement: Event quantities carry no price; value needs the reference rate valid on each event date.

items.name: Tiny master with many inbound links
items.statement: A master of 20 rows or fewer that many tables point at is a business master, not noise.

items.name: Usage without money, costed per unit
items.statement: Usage rows have no money column; cost needs the per-unit cost reference.

items.name: Two groups joined through a shared hub
items.statement: Records of two groups only combine through the shared hub table.

items.name: One high-value table
items.statement: A small table whose values dominate the portfolio value must rank as high value.
